pluginConfigFields.label: Python 3 path
pluginConfigFields.help: The scan engine runs under Python 3.8 or newer. Leave this empty to use the one found on this computer; set it to the full path of a `python3` to use that one instead.

pluginConfigFields.label: Scan engine override
pluginConfigFields.help: Leave this empty to use the engine that ships with the plugin. Set it to the full path of a compiled `ad600_engine_bin` to run that instead, which needs no Python.

deviceConfigFields.label: IP address
deviceConfigFields.help: The AD600's address. It has to be on the same network (subnet) as this computer: the scan does not cross a router.

deviceConfigFields.label: Component ID
deviceConfigFields.help: Normally left empty: the AD600 announces its own. Fill it in only if this AD600 is never found by itself, with the 32 hexadecimal digits of its ACN component ID.
